verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a locally run AI video-production tool. A tool like this could plausibly expose a versioned API, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents a web UI, npm scripts (doctor, post-video) and environment-variable configuration, with no mention of a versioned API or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
